## Ctx.handleSessionCaptionVoice() method

Optional `handleSessionCaptionVoice` route handler declaration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
handleSessionCaptionVoice?(): Promise<unknown>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

## Remarks

Executed on `voice` updates while the session is active. Routing id=1 (session) runs BEFORE static/intent matching (id=2-3): it reads `ctx.getSession().method` — set via [Ctx.setSessionCaptionVoice()](./gramstax.ctx.setsessioncaptionvoice.md) which wires [Ctx.methodSessionCaptionVoice()](./gramstax.ctx.methodsessioncaptionvoice.md) — and dispatches this handler through `new Page(ctx)`<!-- -->. When no session is active, the same update falls through to the non-session route [Ctx.handleCaptionVoice()](./gramstax.ctx.handlecaptionvoice.md) instead.
